arguments.sql:
WITH product_month_sales AS (
  SELECT s.prod_id, t.calendar_year AS sales_year, t.calendar_month_number AS month,
         SUM(s.amount_sold) AS amount
  FROM main.sales AS s
  JOIN main.customers AS c ON c.cust_id = s.cust_id
  JOIN main.countries AS co ON co.country_id = c.country_id
  JOIN main.times AS t ON t.time_id = s.time_id
  JOIN main.promotions AS p ON p.promo_id = s.promo_id
  JOIN main.channels AS ch ON ch.channel_id = s.channel_id
  WHERE co.country_name = 'France'
    AND p.promo_total_id = 1 AND ch.channel_total_id = 1
    AND t.calendar_year IN (2019, 2020, 2021)
  GROUP BY s.prod_id, t.calendar_year, t.calendar_month_number
),
by_product_month AS (
  SELECT month, prod_id,
         MAX(CASE WHEN sales_year = 2019 THEN amount END) AS sales_2019,
         MAX(CASE WHEN sales_year = 2020 THEN amount END) AS sales_2020,
         MAX(CASE WHEN sales_year = 2021 THEN amount END) AS sales_2021
  FROM product_month_sales
  GROUP BY month, prod_id
),
coverage AS (
  SELECT month,
         COUNT(sales_2019) AS products_2019,
         COUNT(sales_2020) AS products_2020,
         COUNT(sales_2021) AS products_2021,
         SUM(sales_2019 IS NOT NULL AND sales_2020 IS NOT NULL) AS paired_products,
         SUM(sales_2019 = 0 AND sales_2020 IS NOT NULL) AS zero_baselines,
         SUM(sales_2019 IS NOT NULL AND sales_2020 IS NOT NULL AND sales_2021 IS NULL) AS paired_without_2021,
         SUM(sales_2021 IS NOT NULL AND (sales_2019 IS NULL OR sales_2020 IS NULL)) AS actual_without_pair
  FROM by_product_month
  GROUP BY month
),
rates AS (
  SELECT month, COUNT(*) AS rate_rows, MIN(to_us) AS min_rate, MAX(to_us) AS max_rate
  FROM main.currency
  WHERE country = 'France' AND year = 2021
  GROUP BY month
)
SELECT coverage.*, rates.rate_rows, rates.min_rate, rates.max_rate
FROM coverage
LEFT JOIN rates USING (month)
ORDER BY month

arguments.sql:
WITH product_month_sales AS (
    SELECT s.prod_id,
           t.calendar_year AS sales_year,
           t.calendar_month_number AS month,
           SUM(s.amount_sold) AS amount
    FROM main.sales AS s
    JOIN main.customers AS cu ON cu.cust_id = s.cust_id
    JOIN main.countries AS co ON co.country_id = cu.country_id
    JOIN main.times AS t ON t.time_id = s.time_id
    JOIN main.promotions AS p ON p.promo_id = s.promo_id
    JOIN main.channels AS ch ON ch.channel_id = s.channel_id
    WHERE co.country_name = 'France'
      AND p.promo_total_id = 1
      AND ch.channel_total_id = 1
      AND t.calendar_year IN (2019, 2020, 2021)
    GROUP BY s.prod_id, t.calendar_year, t.calendar_month_number
),
monthly_averages AS (
    SELECT target.month,
           ROUND(AVG(
               (
                   (recent.amount - prior.amount) / NULLIF(prior.amount, 0)
                   * recent.amount + recent.amount
               ) * COALESCE(fx.to_us, 1.0)
           ), 2) AS average_projected_sales_usd
    FROM product_month_sales AS target
    LEFT JOIN product_month_sales AS prior
      ON prior.prod_id = target.prod_id
     AND prior.month = target.month
     AND prior.sales_year = 2019
    LEFT JOIN product_month_sales AS recent
      ON recent.prod_id = target.prod_id
     AND recent.month = target.month
     AND recent.sales_year = 2020
    LEFT JOIN main.currency AS fx
      ON fx.country = 'France'
     AND fx.year = target.sales_year
     AND fx.month = target.month
    WHERE target.sales_year = 2021
    GROUP BY target.month
),
ranked_months AS (
    SELECT average_projected_sales_usd,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY average_projected_sales_usd) AS month_rank,
           COUNT(*) OVER () AS month_count
    FROM monthly_averages
    WHERE average_projected_sales_usd IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT AVG(average_projected_sales_usd) AS median_average_monthly_projected_sales_usd
FROM ranked_months
WHERE month_rank IN ((month_count + 1) / 2, (month_count + 2) / 2)
LIMIT 1
